ratio_definition: 100*(median59 unit price / median84 unit price - 1), then one vote per complex.
ratio_interval: 5 percentage-point bins; read both endpoints inclusively and withhold sign at zero.
coverage_interval: 10 percentage-point bins; denominators differ between trade coverage and selected-parent share.

grid.strata_selection: Age and price strata only invariant/minimum5; all stratum uses both policies/minimums.
grid.final_year_second_half: July–September2026 only; compare separate historical July–September window.
grid.absence: No supported output in the declared grid; no distinction between unobserved and insufficient samples.

limitations: Different homes within a canonical complex; not identical floor, view, condition or layout.
Current build year and contemporaneous84 total-price strata are descriptive, not independent causes.
Overlapping periods and sensitivity definitions are not independent observations.
Paired changes differ from differences between medians. Matching is restricted to invariant/minimum5 parents.
No individual complex identity, transaction amount, count, or unit price is published.
provisional: 2026-09 and recent reported contracts may be revised;2026 second half contains July–September only.

definitions.primary: Exclusive square-pyeong rounded half-up17/18 versus25/26; invariant eligible sales including observed direct/cancelled labels; land leasehold excluded.
definitions.exact: 59 <= actual exclusive square metres <60 versus84 <= actual exclusive square metres <85.
definitions.strict: Exclude observed cancellation/direct labels; historical blanks are not confirmation of ordinary transactions.
definitions.unit_price: Divide each reported amount by actual decimal exclusive square metres before per-complex/period/size medians; then form each complex ratio and equal-complex-weight quantiles.
definitions.age: Contract year minus current canonical construction year; unknown/future year separate.
definitions.price_stratum: Same-period84 total-price median in eok KRW; descriptive outcome-based group, not an independent cause.
definitions.common_month: Both sizes observed in at least two common months, at least5 selected trades each; pooled and equal-month alternatives.
definitions.floor: Known common floor band with at least5 trades each; equal-band summary gives each complex one vote.
definitions.month_floor: Known shared month/floor cells, at least two shared months and5 selected trades each; pooled and equal-cell alternatives.
definitions.coverage: Trade share uses common contracts/all eligible size-selected contracts; matching share uses selected/base common complexes.
definitions.intervals: Closed conservative5percentage-point ratio and10percentage-point share bins; not confidence intervals. A zero endpoint leaves direction unresolved.
